title: CFaiRLLM: Consumer Fairness Evaluation in Large-Language Model Recommender System

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting explicit gender identities (e.g., "Female") into recommender system prompts and comparing the resulting top-k recommendations against a neutral baseline and the user's actual ground-truth preferences using similarity and True Preference Alignment metrics.

Adding explicit age group identifiers (e.g., "Teen", "Young", "Adult") into prompts for LLM recommenders and measuring the deviation in recommendation lists from a neutral prompt, evaluating fairness through Jaccard Similarity, PRAG, and true preference matching.

Combining multiple sensitive attributes simultaneously (e.g., gender and age together, such as "Young Adult Female") in user prompts to assess how overlapping identities impact recommendation disparities and amplify fairness gaps.
